requiredFindings.summary: The CI-T28 reference oracle imports production descent, status-read, and regular-open cost helpers, so shared pricing defects can leave E_launch and B_hat checks green instead of being independently enumerated.
The exact-work oracle still allocates an extra hop when lookup S + 1 finds a link and does not exercise the corrected cyclic refusal through E_launch <= B_launch <= B_hat_launch.
A checked joined-hop length overflow is classified and latched as Association instead of the Budget(Arithmetic) refusal required for launch accounting overflow.
